title: Cybernetic Witch in Neon Kitchen
description: A tall female cyborg with curved metallic horns and glowing circuitry stands in a dilapidated retro kitchen, her body dripping with colorful paint. She holds a glowing blue blade while an old CRT television, refrigerator, and hanging lamp fill the cluttered room. Multiple floating eyes and a robot appear in the smoky green background through a broken window showing a dystopian city skyline.
